instructions: Finely chop the onion and the green onions. Mince the garlic. Chop 1/4 cup of the dill.
Heat 3 tbsp of the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, until soft and shiny but not brown.
Add the sugar, the green onions and the garlic. Cook for 1 minute, until the garlic smells good.
Add the frozen fava beans, the salt and 1 1/4 cups of water.
Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer, partly covered, for 15 minutes, until the beans are tender.
Take the pot off the heat, cover it and leave it for 15 minutes to cool to room temperature.
Squeeze in the juice of half the lemon and stir in half of the dill. Cut the other half of the lemon into wedges.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt or a squeeze of lemon.
Transfer to a serving dish and drizzle with the remaining olive oil. Serve at room temperature with the rest of the dill and the lemon wedges.
method_notes: Almost Turkish Recipes (the lead) and Delicious Istanbul both cook fava beans slowly in olive oil with onion, garlic and dill and serve them cool. Almost Turkish uses frozen beans, green onions, sugar and a little flour and lemon in the cooking water; the flour is left out here to keep it gluten-free. Delicious Istanbul uses fresh pods. Neither page showed a rating, so this is a fallback lead. The sources serve it with crusty bread and garlic yogurt, which would break the vegan and gluten-free tags, so they are not on the list.
